If you get stuck while following the manual, here is where to turn.

Looking for a quick answer instead of contacting someone? Check the
[FAQ](faq.qmd) first — it collects the recurring questions and errors from
across the manual.

## Get help

Pick the route that matches your problem — they reach different teams.

- **`bp-submission-pipeline` — bugs, confusing steps, or unexpected behaviour:**
  open an issue on
  [imi-bigpicture/bp-submission-pipeline](https://github.com/imi-bigpicture/bp-submission-pipeline/issues).
  This is the primary route: it reaches the people who maintain the pipeline, and
  the answer stays visible to the next operator who hits the same thing. If you
  cannot use GitHub, email the [servicedesk](mailto:{{< var email.helpdesk >}})
  instead and it will be picked up from there.
- **Server or data-archive issues** — the BigPicture inbox, the upload endpoints,
  or the archive your datasets land in: email
  [bp-ops](mailto:{{< var email.bpops >}}), the WP2 team that operates those
  servers.
- **General and technical support, and access requests:**
  [servicedesk](mailto:{{< var email.helpdesk >}}).

## When you ask, include

To get a useful answer quickly, tell us:

- Which **manual step** you were on — the letter and name, e.g. *F. TLS + credentials* — and the exact command you ran.
- The **output you got** versus what the *Verify* box said to expect.
- Your **operating system** (Windows / macOS / Linux).

## Reporting issues

Filing an issue is itself a form of community participation — it surfaces a
problem for other operators before they hit it, and it's how the pipeline and
this manual improve. If you hit a bug, a confusing step, or a gap in the
documentation, file it against the project that owns whatever broke:

- **Pipeline behaviour** (the `bp-submission-pipeline` stack, its Make
  targets, or one of its bundled components): open an issue on
  [imi-bigpicture/bp-submission-pipeline](https://github.com/imi-bigpicture/bp-submission-pipeline/issues).
- **`sda-cli`** (the upload client used by the direct path, and by the pipeline
  under the hood): open an issue on
  [NBISweden/sda-cli](https://github.com/NBISweden/sda-cli/issues).
- **This manual** (missing steps, unclear instructions, broken links): open an
  issue on [imi-bigpicture/portal.bigpicture.eu](https://github.com/imi-bigpicture/portal.bigpicture.eu/issues).

Include what you were trying to do, the exact command or page, and what you
expected versus what happened — the same detail listed under
[When you ask, include](#when-you-ask-include) above.

## Out of scope

Support covers the submission pipeline itself. Custom data transformations and
your own infrastructure setup are outside what these channels can troubleshoot.
